acceptanceCriteria: Normal archive moves canonical artifacts and all recognized failed-attempt outcome/event variants, preserving bytes and manifest digests.
Superseded archive applies the same variant handling and never leaves recognized Work Item artifacts in active.
Existing orphan variants with an already archived Work Item have an explicit, identity-bound reconciliation path; no manual deletion is required.
Status/doctor expose orphaned active artifacts separately from valid active Work Items; activeWorkItems count remains contract-based and cannot hide residue.
Archive manifests validate historical variant paths and digests while remaining backward compatible with existing manifests.
Two repositories remain isolated; object/adopter acceptance proves the same behavior using the installed Runtime.
Three-language documentation explains active staging, failed-attempt history, archive, and close boundaries.
goal: 归档并可审计地整理失败尝试产物，准确暴露 active 残留，避免新 Work Item 在不清洁状态下启动。
intent: 修复 Work Item 失败尝试产物留在 active 目录且状态统计无法识别的生命周期缺口，并保证安装对象工程继承同样的收尾语义。
outOfScope: release automation and provider branch cleanup
historical evidence byte rewriting or deletion

scenarioCoverage.expected: Normal archive preserves and relocates recognized failed-attempt variants.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Repository archive regression test with outcome/event variants.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Superseded archive does not leave recognized variants in active.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Recovery/supersession regression test with manifest digest checks.

scenarioCoverage.expected: An already archived Work Item can reconcile residual variants without deletion.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Identity-bound reconciliation test against an existing archive manifest.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Status distinguishes valid active Contracts from orphaned active artifacts.
Two repositories cannot move or report each other's Work Item artifacts.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Parallel two-repository isolation regression test and installed Runtime smoke.
